section_summary.extract_value: This section describes participants from two distinct studies: Study 1 comprised 140 Zimbabwean women from Harare (mean age 25.34 years, mean BMI 24.81 kg/m²), and Study 2 comprised 138 first-generation Zimbabwean migrant women from London, Britain (mean age 26.61 years, mean BMI 24.88 kg/m²). Both samples were recruited from the community and reported their BMI; ancestry composition is provided but educational attainment and body appreciation assessment methods are not specified in this section.
